content.value: A linear resistance potentiometer (POT) is 50 mm long and is uniformly wound with a wire having resistance of 10 kΩ. Under normal conditions, the slider is at the center of the POT. Find the linear displacements when the resistance of the POT as measured by a Wheatstone bridge are respectively 3850 Ω and 7560 Ω. Are the two displacements in the same direction?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2020
